title: fight.shots/1 (docs/architecture/shots.md)
description: data/fight/shots.json: energy blasts in flight (sim/core/shots.gd): the cap on live shots, the arrival bound of a seeking shot, the fighter's contact size, what a deflect does (the share of its kind's speed, the arc by band), whether shots stop at buildings, the mine limits, and each kind's speed (units a tick), radius, trade power, plain damage and flight times. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore; the kinds are an open table of closed records.

arriveTicks.description: A seeking shot arrives within this many ticks.

chest.description: A fighter's centre above his feet.

bodyR.description: A fighter's radius for a shot's contact.

kinds.description: The kinds of shot, by name.

speed.description: Units a tick (a minimum for a seeking shot). 0 only for a mine.

r.description: Its radius, for contact and trades.

dmg.description: What a plain hit does (a placeholder until the director's blasts set their own).

lifeTicks.description: How long a straight shot flies.

lobArc.description: A lobbed shot's height above the straight line.

mine.description: This kind is a mine: it stays where it is laid.

trigR.description: A rival's centre within this sets it off.

blastR.description: Its blast hits every fighter within this.

chainR.description: Its blast sets off the mines within this.

fuseBodyTicks.description: Ticks from set off to blast when a body set it off (a fighter in the trigger radius, or a blow).

fuseShotTicks.description: Ticks from set off to blast when a shot set it off.

chainTicks.description: Ticks between the mines of a chain.

ownShare.description: The share of its damage its owner takes inside the blast.

tierR.description: The radii's growth by its owner's tier.

structures.description: A straight or lobbed shot stops at a standing front-row building its path crosses.

deflect.description: What a deflect does to a shot.

scatter.description: true: the shot flies wild to a seeded spot on the ground. false: it flies back at its owner.

nearMin.description: The near band of landing distances, in units.

farChance.description: The share of deflects that land in the far band.

awayChance.description: The share that land on the side away from the shooter.

speedMul.description: The wild shot flies at this share of its own kind's speed.

arcNear.description: The arc's height per unit of landing distance in the near band.

arcFar.description: The arc's height per unit of landing distance in the far band.

safeTicks.description: Ticks for which it cannot hit the fighter who deflected it.

backCos.description: It never leaves within the angle with this cosine of the line back to the shooter.

mineCap.description: Mines one fighter may have laid at once.

mineGap.description: A mine cannot be laid within this of another.
